Subject: Visitor ID Clearinghouse & Badge-swap Protocols for Sapphire Financial exec workshop

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for hosting the exec workshop next Tuesday. To make on-site check-in smooth for the ~18 external guests and our 6-person Redwood team, wanted to confirm your preferred approach for temporary badges and one short exception we often see with multi-floor visits (guest moves between client floor and secure boardroom).

Quick proposal (we can adapt):
- Pre-register all external visitors in the attached visitor_manifest_template.csv and send to your security ops 48 hours prior.
- On arrival, Venue Security issues a temporary badge with escort-only access by default.
- For the secure boardroom on 12th floor, we request a short-term badge swap process: Redwood guests leave lobby badge with your security desk and receive a 12th-floor visitor credential for the duration of the meeting; we return it immediately after departure.

Questions from our side so we can finalize the mutual action plan:
1) Do you require a separate escort for non-RNW (non-Redwood) visitors between floors?
2) Any restrictions on electronic devices in the 12th-floor boardroom? (we can supply a locked polybox if needed)
3) Is your badge-swap log (badge out / badge in) acceptable if maintained manually at the desk, or do you need a signed MOP (Method of Procedure) which we can circulate?

I attached a draft MOP for the badge-swap process and a temporary badge label PDF for reference. If this looks good, I’ll share the manifest and finalize with Stephanie and Monica on our end.

Thanks — we want to avoid hold-ups at check-in.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Jonas —

Appreciate the proposal, and welcome back to our office. A few items from Security Ops (copied) below; I added notes inline.

- Pre-registration: yes, please send the completed CSV by Sunday evening (48 hours prior to arrival). We will do a name-check and pre-print lobby badges.
- Escorting: Sapphire policy requires an escort for any visitor moving from public spaces to secure floors. If Redwood prefers a dedicated escort for the workshop (recommended), we can provide one for the duration; otherwise one of your team members must escort.
- Badge-swap: we allow temporary credential swaps for boardroom access under two conditions:
  1) A security desk log is maintained (manual is okay) — must include name, badge ID issued at check-in, time out/in, and escort initials.
  2) Devices: no cameras or recording devices allowed in the 12th-floor room; phones must be left with the security desk in a sealed envelope unless pre-authorized.

Regarding the MOP: Security asks for the signed MOP from Redwood if the badge is to be handled by your lead. Please use the attached template and return the signed copy to security@sapphirefin.com.

I’ll coordinate the escort schedule with Venue Solutions and copy back.

Best,
Elena
Elena Costa | Head of Executive Events, Sapphire Financial

I’ve attached our draft badge-swap MOP; small edits welcome.

Thanks all — keep replies short so we can send finalized materials to Elena before their 48-hour window closes.
